revenueProvenance.comparabilityBasis: Groups describe additive monetary-income definitions, not fiscal-year identity or weighted-average-share EPS. IAS18/IAS17 applies through 2016. The published FY2017/H12017 IFRS15 restatements share the 2018 IFRS15/IAS17 basis; they are not grouped with original IAS18 years. IFRS16 periods from 2019 share consolidated before-gaming-tax operating revenue, reported operating profit and explicit expensed D&A. The same-format 2023/2022 comparative in mgm-2023-annual/page158 bridges the concession renewal without changing these definitions: actual concession charges remain included, not restated to a pro forma contract. FY2025 in mgm-2025-annual/page157 and the paired H12025/H12026 columns in mgm-2026-interim/page47 use that common basis, permitting FY2025 minus H12025 plus H12026 for available additive income fields. EPS is retained as published and is not additive.
